title: Product designer mobile & web | remote
description:
Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.

We’re expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.

We’re looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude . You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you’ve been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.

The role

You’ll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You’ll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.

The role will include:

Product discovery and exploring new ideas Turning early ideas into clear user journeys Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing Designing across i OS, Android and web Working with and improving our design systems Working closely with developers throughout implementation Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business

There’s a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.

What matters to us

Attention to detail is a big one.

We need someone who naturally spots things that don’t quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.

We also want someone who can work independently. You won’t always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you’ll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.

You should be curious and proactive. Look at what other products are doing, bring new ideas to the team and be willing to challenge something if you think there’s a better way of doing it.

We’re a very collaborative team, so you need to be comfortable sharing your work, receiving feedback and changing direction when needed. We move quickly and priorities can change, so being flexible is important. Sometimes something else becomes more important and we all need to jump in and help.

We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership of their work . The job doesn’t finish when a design is handed over to development. We expect our designers to look at what has actually been built, use it and help make sure the final experience is right.

What we're looking for

Relevant experience as a Product / UX/UI Designer A strong portfolio showing real digital products you’ve worked on Experience designing for mobile and web Good understanding of i OS and Android UX patterns Experience with discovery, user flows and prototyping Experience creating prototypes for interviews and user testing Experience working with design systems Comfortable working closely with developers Able to work independently and take ownership of a piece of work Very strong attention to detail Curious, proactive and happy to bring ideas to the table Comfortable working in a startup where things can move quickly Fluent English , written and spoken

The setup

Remote Contractor / PJ Monday to Friday The team starts at 7:30am Brazil time , so you need to be available for our daily meetings and team discussions Looking for someone who can start as soon as possible

Please include a link to your Product Design portfolio in your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small design challenge and then talk us through how they approached it and why they made the decisions they did.

title: Mid-level accountant
description:
Company Description:

4 ARC Consulting provides outsourced accounting, financial operations, and fractional CFO services to small and mid-sized businesses across multiple industries. We support clients with accurate financial reporting, streamlined accounting processes, and actionable financial insights.

We are growing our accounting team and looking for a Mid-Level Accountant who is detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable supporting multiple U. S.-based clients.

Responsibilities

Perform day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for multiple client accounts. Categorize and review transactions and maintain accurate general ledger records. Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations. Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other month-end adjustments. Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close. Review accounts payable and accounts receivable activity. Record and reconcile payroll entries based on payroll reports. Prepare and review Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss statements, and other financial reports. Investigate account discrepancies and resolve reconciliation issues. Maintain supporting schedules and accounting documentation. Assist with accounting cleanups, catch-up projects, and system migrations. Work with senior accounting and finance professionals to support client reporting and financial analysis. Communicate professionally with the 4 ARC team regarding open items, missing documentation, and accounting issues. Support multiple clients while meeting established deadlines and maintaining confidentiality.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. 3–5+ years of accounting experience preferred. Strong understanding of accounting principles, general ledger accounting, and month-end close. Experience with bank reconciliations, journal entries, AP, AR, and financial statement preparation. Experience with Quick Books Online strongly preferred. Experience with systems such as Sage Intacct, Net Suite, SAP, or similar ERP/accounting platforms is a plus. Experience supporting U. S.-based companies or working with U. S. GAAP is a strong plus. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify accounting discrepancies independently. Ability to manage multiple companies, clients, and deadlines simultaneously. Professional written and verbal communication skills in English. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a U. S.-based team.

What We're Looking For:

We are looking for someone who goes beyond basic data entry. The right candidate should understand how transactions flow through the financial statements, recognize when something does not look correct, investigate discrepancies, and take ownership of assigned accounting work.

You should be organized, proactive, comfortable asking questions when needed, and capable of working independently once processes and expectations are established.

title: Gerente de biogás
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Regenera Rio:

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, vindos de casas, comércios e indústrias, garantindo que tenham um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a criação de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia de reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação resulta na redução de impactos ambientais causados pela disposição incorreta dos resíduos, em melhorias diretas na saúde e qualidade de vida da população carioca e no avanço da economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Principais Desafios da Posição:

• Atuar em uma operação de altíssima complexidade e escala, referência no Brasil e América Latina.

Experiência em operações industriais, ambientais, resíduos, energia, gás ou plantas de processo contínuo. Vivência com operação de campo, plantas 24h e times técnicos. title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description:
About Us:

Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Analista fiscal sênior (impostos diretos e indiretos)
description:
China Mobile International Brazil is seeking a Tax Executive to join our growing team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company’s tax activities, ensuring accurate tax calculations, compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, timely submission of tax obligations, and proper management of tax-related documentation and processes.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.

Work Location: Paulista Area, São Paulo

Work Model: 100% On-site

Job Responsibilities Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary. Prepare and submit ancillary tax obligations, such as GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, DIRF, among others. Collaborate with external accounting firms throughout the tax assessment process by providing accurate and timely information and documentation. Support internal and external audits by gathering, reviewing, and providing all required documentation and information. Keep tax clearance certificates up to date to support participation in public tenders and ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements. Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications. Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST. Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team. Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information. Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies. Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients. Participate in internal projects by providing tax guidance and proposing solutions to ensure tax compliance and operational efficiency. Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis. Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements. Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company. Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field. Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes. Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF. Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST. Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices. Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred. Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company’s operations. Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

• Position offered shall be determined by the candidate’s years of relevant experience and skillsets.

• All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.

A Legraz Group busca um(a) advogado(a) com sólida experiência em Proteção de Dados, Direito Digital e Compliance para integrar sua equipe consultiva.

Procuramos um profissional com perfil estratégico, capacidade de relacionamento com clientes e experiência na implementação de programas de privacidade, governança de dados e adequação à LGPD, atuando em projetos de alta complexidade para empresas de diversos segmentos.

A atuação será presencial em Sorocaba/SP .

Principais responsabilidades

Assessorar empresas em questões relacionadas à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), Direito Digital e governança da informação; Atuar na implementação e manutenção de Programas de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados; Exercer atividades relacionadas à função de DPO (Encarregado pelo Tratamento de Dados), inclusive em projetos de DPO as a Service; Elaborar e revisar políticas de privacidade, políticas internas, normas corporativas, termos de uso, avisos de privacidade e demais documentos relacionados à proteção de dados; Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos com cláusulas de proteção de dados e segurança da informação; Conduzir diagnósticos de maturidade, mapeamentos de dados (data mapping), avaliações de riscos e relatórios de conformidade; Elaborar pareceres jurídicos e prestar consultoria estratégica em Direito Digital, Privacidade e Compliance; Apoiar clientes na resposta a incidentes de segurança e em demandas envolvendo a Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD); Ministrar treinamentos e workshops sobre LGPD, privacidade e boas práticas de governança; Atuar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo Tecnologia da Informação, Recursos Humanos, Compliance e Segurança da Informação.

Requisitos

Graduação em Direito com inscrição ativa na OAB; Experiência comprovada em Proteção de Dados, Direito Digital e LGPD; Vivência na implementação de programas de privacidade e governança de dados; Experiência em elaboração e negociação de contratos envolvendo tratamento de dados pessoais; Conhecimento em gestão de riscos, Compliance Corporativo e governança; Excelente capacidade de redação jurídica e comunicação com clientes; Perfil consultivo, analítico e orientado à solução de problemas.

Diferenciais

Pós-graduação ou especialização em Proteção de Dados, Direito Digital, Compliance ou áreas correlatas; Certificações reconhecidas na área (EXIN Privacy & Data Protection, IAPP, CIPM, CIPP/E, CDPO, ISO 27701, ISO 27001 ou equivalentes); Experiência atuando como DPO interno ou externo; Conhecimento em Segurança da Informação, Governança Corporativa e Gestão de Riscos; Inglês intermediário ou avançado; Produção de conteúdo técnico (artigos, palestras, cursos ou publicações); Participação ativa em eventos, associações e comunidades de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados; Presença profissional consolidada no Linked In e boa rede de relacionamento no mercado.

O perfil que buscamos

Mais do que conhecimento jurídico, buscamos um profissional que seja referência técnica, tenha visão estratégica de negócios, saiba construir relacionamento com clientes e queira participar do desenvolvimento de uma prática jurídica moderna, consultiva e altamente especializada.

* Relacionamento ativo com construtoras, incorporadoras, arquitetos ou clientes do mercado premium;

* Conhecimento do mercado imobiliário e de interiores em Santa Catarina;

* Estrutura técnica para projetos sob medida;

* Atuação em mercado de alto padrão;

title: Head de dados
description:
Sobre nós
Somos uma empresa de i Gaming (apostas e poker) em forte crescimento, com várias marcas e produtos — apostas esportivas, poker, pagamentos e KYC. O time de tecnologia opera de forma AI-first: agentes de IA fazem parte do fluxo de trabalho cotidiano, e o time de dados atua como orquestrador dessa tecnologia. Linha direta com quem decide. CEO hands‑on, sem camadas de aprovação. Base limpa para construir. Data Warehouse recém‑reconstruído com fundação moderna. Você evolui em cima de algo sólido, não apaga legado. Problemas que importam. Escala real de i Gaming: segmentação, recomendação, detecção de padrões, jogo responsável e AML. Mandato para montar o time. Autonomia ampla para estruturar, contratar e escalar do seu jeito. O que você vai fazer
Assumir e evoluir uma arquitetura de dados moderna, priorizando o roadmap com o time e os agentes de IA. Definir os padrões de como o time opera com agentes de IA: spec, revisão de plano e output, governança e observabilidade. Levar IA ao produto: segmentação, recomendação, detecção de padrões e jogo responsável. Escalar o time: estruturar, contratar com critério, mentorar e desenvolver autonomia. Garantir compliance regulatório (SIGAP, LGPD, auditabilidade de IA) como condição de operação. Ser a ponte entre o time técnico, a diretoria e as áreas que consomem dados. O que buscamos
Histórico de construção + experiência liderando e escalando time técnico de dados ou engenharia. Profundidade técnica em arquitetura moderna (Data Warehouse colunar, dbt, orquestração, cloud, Ia C, CDC/streaming). Visão de produto e negócio; mentalidade de dono; comunicação clara com áreas não técnicas. Vivência em startup ou scale‑up com recurso escasso e problema mal definido. Diferenciais
Experiência em i Gaming, fintech ou outro setor regulado e data‑intensive. Vivência com compliance (KYC/AML, LGPD, privacidade). Histórico de instalar cultura analítica e formar data promoters. Como é trabalhar aqui
Cultura informal e direta, hierarquia enxuta, decisões rápidas e autonomia ampla. O time de tecnologia opera com agentes de IA no fluxo cotidiano — não como piloto, como padrão. Valorizamos quem constrói e entrega. Importante:
não buscamos um gestor apenas estratégico nem um executor individual. O perfil ideal é alguém que tenha bagagem técnica, saiba liderar e tenha autonomia para construir e escalar a área de Dados.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Electrical bim/vdc coordinator

title: Ai operations
description:
About Liora

Liora is an energy fintech: we operate distributed generation assets across Brazil and turn the savings they generate on clients' electricity bills into financial products, credit, cashback and benefits, without increasing what clients pay.

Most people treat their electricity bill as a fixed, unavoidable cost, something you pay and forget.

What they don't realize is that energy has all the characteristics of a financial asset: it's recurring, predictable, and present in virtually every household and business budget. Liora was built on that insight.

The electricity bill stops being a burden and becomes a channel for economic opportunity, especially for the small businesses that traditional finance has always underserved.

We're building an AI-first operation where agents score credit & risk, approve or decline applications, and run ownership transfers across dozens of energy distributors.

This is not an automation project. It is a real business operation with real clients, real volume and real consequences, designed from day one to be run by AI agents.

We are looking for the person who will make it work.

What you'll operate

Credit & Risk

Deciding who is a good payer, who is too risky, and under what terms we should accept each client.

Define and apply credit & risk criteria: evaluate payment behavior, energy consumption and other signals to determine approval, limits and risk. Run and improve the operation:m onitor decisions, portfolio health, default rates and edge cases, turning learnings into better rules and processes. Own the AI agents: define how they analyze applications, what they handle autonomously and where they escalate to you.

Ownership Transfer

Getting every new consumer unit (UC) fully switched over to Liora across dozens of distributors with different rules and systems.

Own the process: map distributor requirements and ensure contracts and documentation are correct. Run and unblock the operation: track transfers, resolve rejections and exceptions, and keep applications moving. Own the AI agents: automate execution, define escalation points and continuously expand what agents can handle.

These are complex, high-volume operations that, in the traditional model, would require large teams. At Liora, we want them run by agents, with you in command.

Who you are

We care less about titles and years of experience than about how you think, learn and solve problems.

You don't need to have done this before. Very few people have. We're looking for someone early enough in their career to be excited by building something from scratch, but ambitious enough to take real ownership from day one.

Degree and industry background don't matter. What matters is that you can move between business judgment and technical execution: understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result and improve it.

You're not waiting for a defined process or formal training to get started. You enjoy figuring things out when there is no obvious answer.

You spend time experimenting with AI agents because you're genuinely curious. You've tested tools, broken things, understood why they broke and tried again.

Why now, why Liora

The energy sector is full of opaque tariffs, fragmented processes and decades of accumulated complexity. Liora is turning that complexity into financial infrastructure for SMBs and high-consumption consumers.

We're backed by Canary, 17 Sigma and 468 Capital. We doubled in size in the first two months of 2026 and project 15x growth by year end.

You'll join while the category is being created, with the autonomy to build the playbook as you go.

The window is open. It won't stay that way forever.

title: Senior accounting manager
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement.

The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounting Manager to run the accounting operation for US-based client companies, working remotely from Brazil.

This is a senior management seat reporting to the Controller or Head of Accounting, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will manage the close, manage the accounting team, and hold first-line accountability for the accuracy of what the function produces before it reaches final review.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who fixes them and writes down how they now work.

You will work closely with the finance leadership, and directly with the operators whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

Because your team sits outside the United States and the leadership you report to does not, the role calls for someone who runs their area without needing to be managed through it, escalates early rather than at review, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture across a time difference.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time. The financial statements. Prepare the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced. Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on. Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review. Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation. Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage. Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you. Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller. External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations and Team

The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards. Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them. Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast. The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands. Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across Net Suite, Quick Books Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.

What We're Looking For

8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Quick Books Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , or Rippling Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded Saa S or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

Run the close and manage the accounting team, with direct visibility to US finance leadership Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities Gain hands-on exposure to audits, ERP transformations, and control build-outs rather than observing them Progress toward Controller, Head of Accounting, and Head of Finance opportunities through MAVI Compensation in USD, paid reliably and on schedule

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will be placed with a single US client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts, and you will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazil business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

description:

About Smartrips and Navan

We are the largest Travel Tech in Brazil and an official Navan partner, serving large corporate clients such as Heineken, Visa, and Unilever, among others. Our consultants are a trusted reference for travelers: they resolve the unexpected quickly, anticipate problems, and treat every booking as if it were their own.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop the team Ensure your team is developing through regular review of interactions, coaching sessions, and 1:1 meetings. Communicate clear expectations so consultants are self-driven and motivated to meet and exceed the expectations of their role. Lead consultants through change as an active change agent, ensuring their understanding and encouraging their feedback. Keep your team globally aligned to organizational expectations, quality, process, and performance through team meetings. Support recruitment of Travel Consultants and new hire inductions to ensure team consistency. Highlight and manage employee performance concerns, escalating to the People team or Senior Leadership when necessary. Cascade travel industry updates and changes to your team.

Quality and performance Maintain an in-depth understanding of the daily responsibilities of Travel Consultants. Perform quality evaluations on Travel Consultant interactions, reviewing travel bookings in travel tools and requests to ensure standards of service are consistently excellent. Monitor and highlight any errors, providing constructive feedback and coaching consultants on preventative actions. Regularly review consultant and team performance metrics to identify areas of opportunity in critical core competencies and provide feedback. Monitor contact queues and SLA performance to ensure appropriate adherence and achievement of goals. Supervise Travel Consultant performance against success metrics. Report on weekly and monthly performance of the operation and, specifically, of your team.

Service and operations Receive and resolve email, voice, and chat interactions. Manage escalations and customer communications, owning customer issues through to completion. Partner with all cross-functional teams to address agent errors and learning needs, and suggest ways to improve Travel Consultant performance. Participate in projects to help develop, guide, and implement effective processes with a successful impact on service delivery and results. Work with Operations and Service Leadership to regularly review, update, and share global metrics for success. Monitor and identify processes or procedures impacting team productivity.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of travel industry knowledge leadership experience in a TMC or travel industry contact center environment. 3 years of travel industry experience at Manager level, managing consultants and leads. Hands-on background in international ticketing within a corporate travel agency. A leisure-only profile does not meet the requirement. Advanced knowledge of Sabre and/or Amadeus GDS, as well as online and offline travel operational processes. At least advanced English: you will report, run meetings, and align with global teams in English. Customer-centric: the customer is at the forefront of everything you do. Able to build relationships and motivate team members by sharing knowledge and encouraging engagement. Proven mentor with a clear understanding of travel service requirements, customers, and the challenges facing a fast-growing company. Excellent, professional communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Data-driven, with the ability to apply business analytics to gain deeper, real-time insights into agent performance and trends.

title: Analista de tesouraria pleno
description:
Visão Geral da Função

Como Analista de Tesouraria Pleno , você será responsável por apoiar a gestão de liquidez, risco cambial, operações bancárias e projetos de tesouraria da companhia para o Brasil e a América Latina. Esta posição desempenha um papel estratégico na elaboração de projeções de fluxo de caixa, monitoramento de exposições cambiais, gestão de cartões corporativos e relacionamento com instituições financeiras, contribuindo para a eficiência financeira e a governança da organização.

Trabalhando em parceria com as áreas de Finanças, Contabilidade, Tributário, Jurídico, Supply Chain e parceiros bancários, você ajudará a identificar oportunidades de otimização de liquidez, mitigação de riscos e melhoria contínua dos processos de tesouraria.

Local de trabalho: São Bernardo do Campo

Horário de trabalho: das 8h00 às 17h00

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (3 dias no escritório e 2 dias trabalhando de casa)

No dia a dia, você irá:

Preparar e atualizar projeções de fluxo de caixa, garantindo informações precisas para o planejamento financeiro e a tomada de decisões. Analisar necessidades de caixa e liquidez, recomendando ações para otimizar o uso dos recursos financeiros da companhia. Apoiar iniciativas relacionadas à gestão de capital de giro, repatriação de dividendos e planejamento de liquidez. Monitorar tendências de utilização de caixa e capital de giro, identificando oportunidades de melhoria no desempenho financeiro. Revisar e documentar exposições cambiais decorrentes das operações comerciais da empresa. Executar e acompanhar operações de hedge aprovadas, garantindo alinhamento às políticas corporativas de tesouraria. Analisar impactos cambiais nos resultados do negócio e colaborar com diferentes áreas para identificar riscos emergentes. Administrar registros de contas bancárias, documentação regulatória, procurações e assinaturas autorizadas. Apoiar a implementação de novos serviços bancários, linhas de crédito, soluções de pagamento, programas de cartões corporativos e estruturas de gestão de caixa. Preparar relatórios e análises relacionados à liquidez, posição de caixa, exposição cambial e atividades bancárias. Gerenciar cartões corporativos e cartões de crédito dos colaboradores, assegurando conformidade com as políticas internas. Manter documentação de suporte para auditorias internas e externas, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos de compliance e controles internos. Apoiar atividades relacionadas à Lei Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) e aos testes de controles da área de Tesouraria. Coordenar atividades de tesouraria relacionadas a importação e exportação em conjunto com Supply Chain, despachantes aduaneiros e instituições financeiras. Monitorar programas de Supply Chain Finance e identificar oportunidades para melhoria do capital de giro e do fluxo de caixa. Participar de projetos locais e regionais de Tesouraria, incluindo iniciativas de melhoria de processos, implementação de tecnologia e transições bancárias. Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para fortalecer os processos, promover melhores práticas e aumentar a eficiência operacional da área.

O que você precisa para ter sucesso:

Ensino superior completo em Finanças, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas. Experiência mínima de 3 anos em Tesouraria, Finanças Corporativas ou instituições financeiras. Experiência com gestão de fluxo de caixa, liquidez, operações bancárias, câmbio ou instrumentos de proteção cambial. Vivência em empresas multinacionais será considerada um diferencial. Conhecimento em gestão de caixa, planejamento de liquidez e gestão de risco cambial. Conhecimento de produtos bancários, operações financeiras e processos de tesouraria. Conhecimento em controles internos, compliance e requisitos regulatórios. Excel avançado para análises financeiras, modelagem e elaboração de relatórios. Experiência com sistemas de gestão de tesouraria, preferencialmente Kyriba ou plataformas similares. Capacidade analítica para interpretação de dados financeiros e resolução de problemas. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento com stakeholders internos e externos. Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades, cumprir prazos e atuar com organização e atenção aos detalhes. Perfil colaborativo, com foco em melhoria contínua, eficiência operacional e gestão de projetos. Espanhol e Inglês será considerado um diferencial. Certificação profissional em Tesouraria (CTP) será considerada um diferencial.

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026

About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2 B Saa S marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2 B Saa S company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the Saa S . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2 C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by "brand recognizes brand" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.

This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.

How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse , and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.

What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets Design static ad systems for Meta, Linked In, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.

You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2 B Saa S portfolio Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves Motion design or animation Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. " It looked great" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.

What We Offer Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually Flexible remote work Generous time off policy Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand Build your portfolio with high-quality B2 B Saa S work that stands out Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product

How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2 B Saa S marketing work) One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked. How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

Garantir que a documentação de engenharia do projeto seja aprovada e concluída dentro do prazo; Participar de reuniões internas de execução do projeto para garantir que os requisitos do cliente sejam disseminados e claramente compreendidos por todos os grupos de apoio; Criar oportunidades para expandir o escopo do projeto por meio de melhores práticas; Garantir que o conhecimento técnico relevante do projeto seja transferido para todos os parceiros internos, local e globalmente, para entregar o projeto completo com sucesso ao cliente; Prestar suporte às equipes de busca de projetos do PMO em suas atividades, conforme necessário; Maximizar as oportunidades para todas as outras divisões da Emerson Process Management sempre que possível; Promover o uso das políticas corporativas da Emerson no ambiente de projetos do PMO.

Quem você é:

Você assume a responsabilidade pelos resultados dos outros. Você age com rapidez e decisão em situações imprevisíveis e que alteram os fatos. Você demonstra grande iniciativa em situações difíceis e é excepcional em identificar e aproveitar oportunidades. Você facilita um diálogo aberto com uma ampla variedade de colaboradores e partes interessadas. Você transmite mensagens de forma clara, convincente e concisa.

Para este cargo, você precisará: Formação em engenharia Elétrica, Aeronáutica, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, de Controle e Automação, Química; 5 anos de experiência, preferencialmente na indústria de instrumentação e/ou controle e automação de processos; Conhecimento em desenhos técnicos; Conhecimento em Office 365; Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais/internacionais; Inglês avançado para reuniões técnicas com equipes e clientes de outros países; Local de trabalho: Sorocaba-SP.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam: Espanhol; Conhecimento em Sistema Oracle; Conhecimento em CRM Cloud; Experiência com atendimento ao cliente.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Ehs supervisor (environmental)
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R& D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo Super Sense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIo T-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities Ensure project activities follow local, state, and federal environmental regulations and company EHS standards. Identify potential environmental hazards before and during project execution. Monitor contractor activities and enforce EHS requirements Conduct routine field checks to evaluate air, water, noise, waste management practices and other EHS topics. Oversee the segregation, storage, transport, and final disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste. Lead incident reporting and support investigations, ensuring corrective actions are implemented, focused on environmental events. Promote environmental awareness through toolbox talks and on-site training Prepare weekly, monthly, and compliance reports for management, customer and regulatory agencies (when applicable). Support emergency preparedness, including drills and response coordination.

Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree or technical qualification in Environmental, Engineering, or related fields Proven experience in Environmental management within wind farm, construction, or energy projects Strong knowledge of environmental management systems, effective communication, risk assessment, and problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with local EHS regulations and standards Experience supervising contractors on-site Advanced English (for multinational environments) Availability to work on-site and travel as required

title: Fonoaudiólogo - atendimento domiciliar
description:
Quem Somos Unimed CNU Somos responsáveis pela operação nacional dos planos de saúde da marca Unimed. Comercializamos assistência médica empresarial com abrangência nacional, levando saúde e bem-estar para mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Com foco no ser humano e no cuidado, sempre buscamos maneiras de estreitar o relacionamento com os nossos colaboradores, beneficiários, clientes e parceiros, proporcionando uma experiência cada vez melhor para todos. Se você tem paixão pelo cuidar e busca uma oportunidade para atuar com foco no acolhimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time.

A Unimed CNU valoriza e apoia a diversidade. Pessoas com deficiência, pluralidades de raça, cor, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, orientações sexuais ou de idade são consideradas para todas as nossas vagas, pois acreditamos na importância de cooperar, compartilhar ideias e pontos de vistas distintos. Todos são bem-vindos.

#Somos Unilover #Unimed CNU

Missão do Cargo Realizar avaliação e tratamento de distúrbios de comunicação, linguagem, fala, audição e deglutição em pacientes em casa. Ele busca promover a independência funcional e a qualidade de vida dos pacientes, adaptando terapias ao ambiente domiciliar. Trabalha em equipe para oferecer suporte e orientação aos pacientes e familiares, visando melhorar continuamente sua saúde e bem-estar.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Realizar visitas e atendimentos fonoaudiológicos em domicílio, garantindo um cuidado integral, humanizado e com visão holística do paciente. Atuar na promoção, prevenção e recuperação da saúde, com foco contínuo na avaliação do risco de broncoaspiração. Conduzir ações de educação, orientação e instrução de cuidados voltadas aos familiares e cuidadores. Realizar prescrições/adequações de consistência dietética (direcionando solicitações aos responsáveis) e inserir pacientes elegíveis nos programas de Medicina Preventiva. title: Account manager
description:
We're Convert Sail, an e-commerce conversion optimization agency. We work with Shopify brands spending $100 K-$1 M+/month on ads, and we move fast. Really fast.

We're looking for an Account Manager to own client relationships and project delivery. You'll manage 8-10 client accounts, coordinate landing page and funnel builds with our design and dev team, and be the main point of contact when clients need something.

This isn't a 9-5 role where you clock out and forget about work. When a client has a launch on Saturday, you're online. When a project is behind, you stay late to fix it. We ship fast, we work weekends when it matters, and most people flame out in the first 90 days because they can't handle the pace.

If that scares you, this isn't the role for you.

If that excites you, keep reading.

What you'll do:

Own 8-10 client relationships and make sure they're happy, on track, and renewing long-term Manage day-to-day client communication and set clear expectations Coordinate landing page and funnel projects with our design and dev team—keep timelines tight and make sure nothing slips Proactively identify and solve client issues before they become fires Track project progress in Click Up and ensure deadlines are met Help clients see ROI from our work so they stick around for 6-12+ months, not 2-3 Be available during USA business hours and occasionally on weekends when client launches require it

What we're looking for:

2+ years of experience managing client accounts in a fast-paced agency, Saa S company, or startup Fluent English speaker with strong written and verbal communication skills You've worked in high-pressure environments before and didn't crack under the weight You're organized, proactive, and don't need someone checking in on you every 2 hours You don't let things fall through the cracks—you follow up, you track details, you close loops Experience with project management tools like Click Up, Asana, or similar Comfortable working remotely, but you don't treat "remote" like "invisible" Bonus: Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization (not required, but helpful)

What we offer:

Compensation: $12/hour ($2,000+/month full-time) + performance bonuses (depending on experience) Fully remote—work from anywhere as long as you're available US hours Work with real scaling brands, not broke startups or tire-kickers Small team, so you'll have real impact and visibility You'll learn more in 6 months here than 2 years at a slow-moving corporate job Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the agency scales

How to apply:

Don't send a resume first.

Record a 4-minute Loom video (free tool, Google it if you don't know it) and tell us:

Why you want this job Why we should hire you A time you had to manage a difficult client situation and how you handled it

Then email the Loom link to: alex@

Subject line must include the word BUILDER. If it doesn't, we'll assume you can't follow instructions and we won't read your application.

If you can't handle recording a 4-minute video, you definitely can't handle this role.

description: Como Analista de FP&A Sênior você atuará como parceiro estratégico da Diretoria Financeira, apoiando o planejamento, o acompanhamento orçamentário e a geração de insights para a tomada de decisão do negócio. title: Senior data aws engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data AWS Platform Engineer with strong expertise in Google Cloud Data platform.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Networking Design secure, scalable AWS environments using Multi-Account architectures. Configure advanced AWS networking including VPCs, Transit Gateways, and Route53. Establish secure connectivity via AWS Direct Connect and VPNs. Implement strict Network Access Control Lists (NACLs) and Security Groups. Migration of on-premises systems to AWS cloud services. Perform regular updates and upgrades to AWS resources and services

Data Platform Engineering Deploy and manage Databricks workspaces across multiple AWS environments. Optimize Databricks clusters for performance, scalability, and cost. Integrate Databricks with AWS data stores like S3, RDS. Implement Unity Catalog for robust data governance and access control.

Automation & CI/CD Write clean, reusable, and modular infrastructure code using Terraform. Manage infrastructure state files securely in remote backends. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for automated testing. Automate the deployment of both AWS resources and Databricks assets.

Security & Operations Implement IAM roles and policies following the principle of least privilege. Monitor system health and performance using AWS Cloud Watch and Prometheus. Set up automated alerts for infrastructure anomalies and cost spikes. Troubleshoot complex networking, deployment, and data pipeline failures.

Required Technical Skills

Cloud Platform: Advanced expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS). Data Tools: Hands-on administration of Databricks (Workspaces, Clusters, Unity Catalog). Infrastructure as Code: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform. CI/CD: Deep experience building and managing Jenkins pipelines. Networking: Strong mastery of TCP/IP, DNS, VPC peering, and routing tables. Scripting: Proficiency in Python, Bash

What You Can Expect from Us Continuous professional development aligned with your career goals Opportunities for international experience A collaborative, diverse, and innovative work environment

Benefits Health Insurance Dental Plan Life Insurance Transportation Allowance Meal/Food Allowance Childcare Assistance Total Pass 24/7 Employee Support Program (psychological, legal, financial) Certification Reimbursement Learning Platform with free training and courses Referral Bonus Program Recognition Program Mentorship and career development platform
